Dear Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
ENGIE VIANEO
in your region regarding the following product:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P8 170000887
Charger ID/Serial No.:
GNYhkf
Problem Description:
Payment Terminal Unreachable
We need to investigate it for the following :
possible causes:
Network cable defect or not connected
Network switch defect
Power supply of payment terminal defect or not connected
IP-address of payment terminal wrong
possible solutions:
Check network configuration of payment-terminal:
Static IP-
address: 10.20.17.50
Subnetmask: 255.255.255.0
Gateway: 10.20.17.2
DNS: 10.20.17.2
Ping terminal (IP: 10.20.17.50)
Kindly refer the schematic where we need to check the connection in between +F11-PZ10 and ethernet.
We need to get into the Network of the Charger and ping the IP 10.20.17.50 & check if it is accessible.
Do let us know, if you need assistance in the Site Intervention in Advance.
And upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since [
08/07/2024
], as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD.
